# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## From cand_0003 (spreadsheetbench run)
- The instruction points at `.capevolve/run_suite/rejected.jsonl` relative to the work dir, but from inside `work/<cand>/` the run dir is `../../`, and rejected.jsonl doesn't exist when nothing was rejected. Give an absolute path, and create an empty file at run start so "missing" isn't ambiguous.
- It would help to auto-generate, for each LEDGER "broke" task, a side-by-side of the last passing trace and the breaking trace (first divergent assistant turn). That was the highest-signal artifact this iteration, and I had to assemble it by hand.
- A shared /tmp contained a `struct.py` that shadows the stdlib for any python run from /tmp. Sandboxed per-run temp dirs would avoid confusing import failures.
